billing-info-fields.title: AMI billing information fields - Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud

account_id.format: A 12-digit AWS account id, written as a string.

availability_zone.format: A region code plus a single trailing letter.

instance_state_name.format: One fixed word, paired with instance_state_code.

values.pending: The instance is launching and not yet running.
values.shutting-down: The instance is in the process of terminating.
values.terminated: The instance has terminated; its storage is gone unless a volume was kept.
values.stopping: The instance is in the process of stopping.
values.stopped: The instance is stopped; compute is released but EBS storage remains.

instance_state_code.format: Integer; only the low byte (0-255) is meaningful, the high byte is AWS-internal.

examples.note: the EBS volume's AttachTime on this pack's sample

values.x86_64: 64-bit x86; the observed value on this pack's sample.
values.x86_64_mac: 64-bit x86 on Apple silicon-hosted Mac instances.
values.arm64_mac: 64-bit ARM on Apple silicon Mac instances.

values.hvm: Hardware virtual machine; the observed value on this pack's sample.
values.paravirtual: Paravirtual (PV) virtualization, legacy instance families only.

hypervisor.quote: The value xen is used for both Xen and Nitro hypervisors.

values.xen: Xen or Nitro hypervisor; the observed value on this pack's sample.

instance_type.format: A family.size string, e.g. t3.nano, m5.large. AWS's valid-values list names several hundred current and legacy types; not reproduced here.

platform_details.format: A billing platform label, one of AWS's 19 platform details/usage operation pairs.

Linux/UNIX.meaning: Paired with usage operation RunInstances. The observed value on this pack's sample.

usage_operation.format: A billing operation code, paired one-to-one with platform_details on AWS's table.

RunInstances.meaning: Linux/UNIX. The observed value on this pack's sample.

RunInstances:1010.meaning: The AMI billing code for Red Hat Enterprise Linux bundled with HA support.
RunInstances:1010.quote: Red Hat Enterprise Linux with HA.

RunInstances:1014.meaning: The billing code for a Red Hat box bundled with both SQL Server Standard and the HA add-on.

RunInstances:1110.meaning: The billing code for a Red Hat box bundled with both SQL Server Enterprise and the HA add-on.

RunInstances:0014.meaning: The billing code for a Red Hat box bundled with just SQL Server Standard, no HA.

RunInstances:0210.meaning: The billing code for a Red Hat box bundled with SQL Server Web edition.

RunInstances:0110.meaning: The billing code for a Red Hat box bundled with SQL Server Enterprise edition.

values.ebs: Root volume is an EBS volume; the observed value on this pack's sample.
values.instance-store: Root volume is ephemeral instance store.

cpu_core_count.format: Integer count of physical CPU cores.

vcpu_count_cim.format: Integer. On this pack's one record it equals CoreCount x ThreadsPerCore (1 x 2 = 2); AWS does not document this computation, so treat it as unconfirmed beyond that arithmetic.

values.optional: IMDSv1 or IMDSv2 both work; the observed value on this pack's sample.
values.required: IMDSv1 is disabled; a caller must use a session token (IMDSv2).

private_ip_address.format: IPv4 address inside the VPC's CIDR.

examples.note: as published in AWS's own CLI reference example verbatim: dashes, not dots. Not a Splunk artifact; do not assume every private IP on this sourcetype parses as an IP shape.

elastic_ip_owner_id.format: A 12-digit AWS account id, or the literal word amazon.

values.amazon: AWS owns the address: an ordinary EC2 public IP, not a customer-allocated Elastic IP.

attachment_status.format: One fixed word, the same vocabulary on an EBS volume attachment and a network interface attachment.

values.attached: Attachment is complete; the observed value on this pack's sample.

values.associated: Has an association (e.g. an Elastic IP) but is not yet attached.
values.attaching: Attachment to an instance is in progress.
values.in-use: Attached and in use; the observed value on this pack's sample.
values.detaching: Detachment from an instance is in progress.

private_dns_name.format: An *.compute.internal (or *.ec2.internal) hostname; empty until the instance is running.

public_dns_name.format: An *.compute.amazonaws.com hostname; empty until the instance is running, and only if the VPC has DNS hostnames enabled.

values.default: Shared hardware; the observed value on this pack's sample.
values.dedicated: Single-tenant hardware dedicated to one account.
values.host: A specific Dedicated Host the caller allocated.
